review.medical: AI medical-content review of general educational wording, not human clinician sign-off. hs-CRP reflects an inflammatory signal; the test cannot identify its cause. No reading is labelled safe, dangerous or attributable to a workout.
review.customer: Heuristic reviews for a newcomer and an experienced tester, not observed customers. The first variants felt like synonym changes; the revised levels add genuine information.

progression.Beginner: Plain-language meaning, reported workout context, uncertainty and a useful next step.
progression.Intermediate: Same case and next step, with liver response, numerical comparison and a temporary-versus-persistent distinction.
progression.Advanced: Same evidence plus acute-phase physiology, biological/assay variation and limits on baseline or cardiovascular-risk interpretation.
